description: Per-member contribution attestation. G6 STRUCTURAL: investmentReturnPromised const false (Charter Rider §2(b) speculative finance prohibition). G8 STRUCTURAL: voluntary + ability-scaled; no premium-as-contract. Contribution amounts stored encrypted (member-by-amount linkage is PII); aggregate published only.

contributorPseudonymDid.description: 30-day rotating pseudonym DID per ADR-2605181200; member-by-amount linkage avoided

contributionAmountEncryptedCid.description: ADR-2605181100 encrypted envelope CID containing contribution amount (PII; not exposed publicly)

memberConsentCid.description: Member consent record for contribution + privacy posture

investmentReturnPromised.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: const false; Charter Rider §2(b) speculative finance prohibition; mutual aid pool is solidarity reserve, NOT investment vehicle

contributionTxCid.description: On-chain USDC transaction CID (when applicable; in-kind/labor variants attested separately)

stewardLaborAttestationCid.description: When labor-equivalent contribution, cross-link to chigiri.stewardLaborAttestation
